────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Branch fast-tests fit in their time limit: build images once, not per run                                                                                       
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
GOAL                                                                                                                                                            
A fast-tests run started by hand on a branch finishes within its job time limit with room to spare.                                                             
                                                                                                                                                                
PURPOSE                                                                                                                                                         
A dispatched branch run builds every image itself (docker compose up -d --build, 10-12 min) where master's runs pull prebuilt images (30 s); with timeout-      
minutes:                                                                                                                                                        
30 the job had no margin left. Run 45426056166 on feat/units-on-map (z2qt08) passed the SQL suite and live-database tests, then hit the limit 11 s into its     
last                                                                                                                                                            
step and showed as cancelled.                                                                                                                                   
                                                                                                                                                                
PRINCIPLE                                                                                                                                                       
The branch run tests the same images it would ship; the limit stays a guard against hangs, not a race against image building.                                   
                                                                                                                                                                
DETAILS                                                                                                                                                         
Options: let workflow_dispatch use the Images workflow's commit-tagged images when they exist (fall back to build), cache the docker build layers, or give the  
build its own step outside the timed test budget. .github/workflows/fast-tests.yaml lines 146-151 (concurrency, timeout-minutes: 30) and 239-252 (Start         
services).                                                                                                                                                      
Seen 2026-11-24: Start services 15:30:28-15:42:05 on the branch vs 15:11:39-15:12:09 on master.                                                                 
                                                                                                                                                                
▸ ACCEPTANCE · j/k or [ ] step · Space ticks · - strikes out                                                                                                    
> ☐ 1. A dispatched fast-tests run on a branch with migrations finishes with conclusion success, its Start services step under 3 minutes or its build step      
       outside the test time limit                                                                                                                              
                                                                                                                                                                
no dependencies
